solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Clubs pursuing goal for victory

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs, the card suit
someone pursuing a goal is on a quest

explanation.surface: A football team chasing a goal to clinch the win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clubs' looks like football teams, but it is the card suit, and 'pursuing goal' is read as the phrase 'on quest'.
explanation.definitionFit: A conquest is a triumph won by force, so it is a synonym for victory.

clue.text: Exaggerate merits of love poetry, two lines

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
verse is poetry
L is the abbreviation for line, so two of them

explanation.surface: Someone overpraising a love poem that is only a couplet long.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversell something is to promote it beyond its real worth, overstating what it has going for it.

clue.text: Expression of uncertainty using odd quotes in religious book

indicators.note: odd means strange or out of order, so the letters are put into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
Mark is one of the Gospels of the New Testament

explanation.surface: Someone voicing doubt by citing strange passages from scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram takes 'in' along with 'quotes', though the surface makes 'in' a preposition.
explanation.definitionFit: The punctuation symbol ? marks a query, a written sign of doubt or uncertainty.

clue.text: In style, if fellow is French designer

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows, spanning their boundaries

parts.note: the last letter of style, all of if, and the start of fellow

explanation.surface: A stylish chap who turns out to be a French designer.
explanation.walkthrough: Gustave Eiffel was the French engineer who designed the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustave Eiffel, the engineer behind the Paris tower, is an example of a famous French designer.

clue.text: Yarn, so to speak, for part of coat

indicators.note: so to speak points to the spoken form, a word with the same sound but another spelling

parts.note: a yarn is a story or tale

explanation.surface: Knitting wool, of sorts, meant for making part of a coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yarn' suggests knitting wool beside the coat, but it means a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailcoat has long tails at the back, so a tail is a part of that coat.

clue.text: Express oneself badly as single female covering summit

indicators.note: in a down clue, one part covering another means it is placed above, so it comes first

parts.note: an unmarried woman is a miss
a summit is a peak

explanation.surface: A lone woman climber fumbling her words at the top of a mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: To misspeak is to say something wrongly or clumsily, a slip in expressing oneself.

clue.text: Period during which fare is reduced for express

definitions.text: Period during which fare is reduced
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a time of eating little or nothing
second meaning: quick, as an express train

explanation.surface: A spell of cheap tickets on an express train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' suggests ticket prices; it is food, and the period is one of abstaining from eating.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast is a time of going without food, and fast also means speedy, like an express service.

clue.text: In excellent health, I agree

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a phrase of consent

explanation.surface: Someone saying they are fit and concurring.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes someone thriving physically and is also a spoken formula of consent, as in 'all right then'.

clue.text: Estrange from an elite that's improperly taken over area

indicators.note: something done improperly is done wrongly, so these letters end up in the wrong order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: Locals estranged from a privileged class that has wrongly seized their district.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to turn them away or make them hostile, a synonym of estrange.

clue.text: Something got from parent for boy — or girl, we hear

indicators.note: we hear points to the sound of a word rather than its spelling

parts.note: Jean is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A parent's gift for a son or a daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: Three routes meet here: an inherited unit, a boy's name, and a girl's name with the same sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A gene is a unit of heredity passed on from a parent, and Gene is also a man's name.

clue.text: Cautious piano duo

parts.note: piano is the musical instruction to play quietly
a duo is a pair, so the piano word is played a second time

explanation.surface: A pair of pianists who play carefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Piano' looks like the instrument, but it is the musical direction meaning quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: Softly-softly describes a careful, patient approach, so it means wary or cautious.

clue.text: Female isn't passionate about king that's timid

indicators.note: about means around, so one word wraps the letter for king

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female
ain't is a colloquial form of isn't
heated means impassioned
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A woman unmoved by a monarch who lacks courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone faint-hearted lacks courage or boldness, which is to say timid.

clue.text: Cooked very badly, needing something done about it

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for an act wraps the other pieces

parts.note: a deed is something done, an act
V is the abbreviation for very
ill means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: A meal so poorly made that something must be done about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilled food is cooked with hot spices such as mustard or cayenne, a specific cooking method.

clue.text: One will have none of it, to be sure

definitions.text: One will have none of it
definitions.meaning: surface reading: someone flatly refusing something
setter's reading: a person who is certain has none of this feeling of uncertainty

explanation.walkthrough: 'Will have none of it' sounds like rejection; the joke is that being sure means having no uncertainty at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubt is the state of uncertainty, the very thing absent from anyone who is sure.

clue.text: Traveller to another country from corrupt regime

indicators.note: corrupt means spoiled or altered, so the letters are changed into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A refugee fleeing a corrupt government abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: An émigré is someone who has left their own country to settle in another, often for political reasons.

clue.text: Design tool or material for carpenter, mostly

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a plane is a carpenter's tool; a plank, his material, works equally well

explanation.surface: A carpenter's tools and timber laid out for a design.
explanation.walkthrough: Either a plane or a plank loses its last letter to the same result, hence the 'or'.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a drawing or scheme, so it is a synonym of design as a noun.

clue.text: Chance of success for religious group seizing power

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: seizing means grabbing hold of, so the group's word wraps around the letter for power

parts.note: a sect is a religious group
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: A cult grabbing control and likely to win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' looks like a link word, but it supplies the opening letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a likelihood of something happening, so a chance of success.

clue.text: Daring pick

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to pull off, as feathers or fruit

explanation.walkthrough: 'Daring pick' reads as a bold choice; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluck is courage as a noun, and to pluck is to pick, as of strings, fruit or feathers.

clue.text: Overly fussy editor, under pressure, opposed to chapter

indicators.note: in a down clue, one part under another is placed after it

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure
ED is the abbreviation for editor
anti means against
C is the abbreviation for chapter

explanation.surface: A nitpicking editor under stress who objects to a chapter.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedantic person is excessively concerned with minor details and rules, so overly fussy.

clue.text: Ducks in absolute alcohol

indicators.note: in says the answer is found inside the words that follow

parts.note: the end of absolute and the start of alcohol

explanation.surface: Birds soaked in pure spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: Teal is its own plural, so it can stand for ducks.
explanation.definitionFit: Teal are small freshwater ducks, an example of the bird, and the word serves as singular or plural.

clue.text: Rum and beer, with last of wine added — or port

indicators.note: rum means odd or peculiar, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: last of means only the final letter of the next word is kept

parts.note: the final letter of wine

explanation.surface: A list of drinks: rum, beer, wine, or a glass of port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' and 'port' both look like drinks; one signals the anagram, the other is a harbour city. Aberdeen is a Scottish seaport.
explanation.definitionFit: Aberdeen is a North Sea harbour city in Scotland, an example of a port.

clue.text: Ring pulled back and forth

indicators.note: back says the word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O
pulled means drawn, read the other way

explanation.surface: A ring tugged to and fro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back and forth' reads as one phrase, but it splits: 'back' is the signal and 'forth' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Onward means forward or ahead, the same sense as forth in 'go forth'.

clue.text: Strengthened or moderated

definitions.meaning: first meaning: hardened, as steel by heating and cooling
second meaning: softened or toned down

explanation.walkthrough: The two definitions seem almost opposite, which is the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempered steel has been toughened by heat treatment, and tempered criticism has been made milder.

clue.text: Speak indistinctly in mass, say

parts.note: M is the symbol for mass
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A churchgoer mumbling during the service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mass' suggests the church service, but it is the physics symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: To mutter is to speak in a low, unclear voice, mumbling the words.

clue.text: With pen, mark tiger that's in bad shape — warden won't let you feed it

definitions.text: warden won't let you feed it

indicators.note: in bad shape means battered out of form, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A zookeeper forbids feeding a sickly tiger in its pen.
explanation.walkthrough: The zoo picture makes 'warden' a keeper; it is a traffic warden, and you feed coins into the device. Topping up is often forbidden in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A traffic warden polices street parking and a driver feeds coins into this roadside device to pay.

clue.text: Casanova finding love in Parisian way

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: rue is French for street
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A seducer finding romance on the streets of Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: A roué is a debauched man devoted to pleasure, and Casanova was the famous Venetian womaniser.

clue.text: Miss no longer hugging a heavenly body

indicators.note: hugging means wrapping around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a woman who has married is no longer Miss but Mrs
taken as written

explanation.surface: A new bride embracing a beautiful-bodied partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun, an example of a celestial object.

clue.text: In no-win situation that is especially difficult, initially

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so only the opening letter of each word is kept

parts.note: the opening letters of these four words

explanation.surface: A deadlock that is hard to break from the very start.
explanation.definitionFit: A tied game is a draw, where neither side wins, so the players are in a no-win situation.

clue.text: Messenger carrying extreme letter from tyrant for king's follower

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so the messenger's word encloses a letter

parts.note: a courier carries messages

indicators.note: extreme letter means a letter at one end of the next word

parts.note: tyrant begins and ends with the same letter

explanation.surface: A messenger bearing a tyrant's letter to the king's attendant.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtier is an attendant at a royal court, one who follows and serves a monarch.

clue.text: Commanding attention with small spear or missile

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a trident is a three-pronged spear and also a British nuclear missile

explanation.surface: An imposing figure armed with a spear or rocket.
explanation.walkthrough: Trident is the name of the UK's submarine-launched nuclear missile as well as a three-pronged spear.
explanation.definitionFit: A strident voice or tone is loud and harsh, so it forces people to take notice.
